review.limitations: Only three hunks were selected, but other hunks also contribute. No score multiplier or adoption claim is made. Tier assignment relies solely on observed implementation and tests without external benefit claims.
review.reason: The change adds a bounded capability—supporting property-group filters in Error Tracking Breakdowns. Backend, schema, and frontend are updated; a relevant test checks correct behavior. This does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction across multiple critical paths, so tier 3 is unsupported. It exceeds maintenance because it changes query semantics and includes validation.
review.posthog_relevance: Allows users to apply event-level property filters when viewing error-tracking issue breakdowns, potentially improving relevance and reducing noise for debugging sessions.
review.uncertainty: Assessment assumes the added filter support is used meaningfully by PostHog customers; no release notes or WPR indicate actual usage. The tier could shift if this feature becomes widely adopted or integrated with higher-impact workflows.
